data.body: INVESTIGATION COMPLETE (INTERMEDIATE, opus). ROOT CAUSE (high conf, empirically confirmed): validate_code_review_dispatch() in validate-review-output.sh accepts {findings:[], summary>=10chars} as SCHEMA_VALID — no positive review-completed marker. The 2-key migration (commit 1752a4c4de, story 6c75-cc5d) removed the incidental scores-presence guard without a replacement, so a garbled/stripped empty payload is byte-equivalent to a genuine no-issues review. Defect at lines 305-319 (required_top={findings,summary}) + 443-448 (summary>=10 is the only completeness check). Confirmed: {findings:[],summary:'All checks passed cleanly.'} -> SCHEMA_VALID exit 0. No existing field carries the signal (review_tier optional/post-injected; reviewer_hash downstream). PRECEDENT: the synthetic-type exemption (parse_error/specialist_error/fallback_exhausted, lines 356-364) already uses a positive 'type' field to distinguish a real infra-empty from garbage — Fix A generalizes this. TWO FIXES: (A) new REQUIRED positive attestation field for empty-findings, emitted by all ~12 code-reviewer-*.md agents [strongest, O5-C2-faithful, fails closed; HIGH blast radius: validator + ~12 agents + contract docs in lockstep; trips COMPLEX 'agent+script' trigger]; (B) require a structured no-issues token inside the existing summary on the empty branch [lighter: validator + agent guidance, preserves 2-key contract; WEAKER — token in free-text, spoofable, arguably 'synthetic']. Both ORTHOGONAL to 284b (fallback_hops). Both need agent guidance changes. Awaiting user approval on approach (Phase D: safeguard modification + competing fixes require explicit approval).
